messages:
Annalise (Design): dropped a short mock + quick video for the embeddings preview + rerank export. Main asks: keep selections when changing filters/sampling, make the rerank label friendlier, and tighten export modal wording for background jobs. vid: https://rwd-mocks/embeds/review_clip.mp4 Ben (Eng): watched. preserving selection is straightforward if we keep selectedIds separate from page state. edge case: if a filter excludes a selected row entirely, show it as "hidden" in the selection pill rather than silently dropping it. Noah (PM): yes to hidden indicator. copy suggestion for the pill: "18 selected (4 hidden by filters) · View hidden". Clicking View hidden should open a focused list showing those rows in context so the user can verify. Annalise (Design): good. also microcopy for rerank score column: rename from "score" to "relevance (0-1)" and add a tooltip: "Higher = more relevant to your query". For the rerank selector, propose a small badge that says "Previewing" when changes aren't applied. Sam (Accessibility): a11y nits: badges that rely on color must also include readable text (e.g., "Previewing"). Add an aria-live region for preview changes so screen readers get updates when the preview count or rerank preview changes. Example hint:
Showing 24 vectors
. Ben (Eng): implementation idea: two-state model: stagedRerank vs activeRerank. staged updates recalc client-side scores for preview; activeRerank is used for export jobs. We'll persist selectedIds and maintain a hiddenCount derived from current filters. Annalise (Design): export modal copy: change primary CTA to "Start export" and include helper text beneath: "Large exports run in background; you'll receive a link when ready." In advanced options show format (CSV/JSONL) and a toggle: "Request checksum (SHA256)". Noah (PM): add an estimated size line in the modal: "Estimated file size: ~3.2 MB (2,000 rows)". If estimate exceeds threshold show a warning: "Large export — will be processed as a background job." Link to docs in the warning. Sam (Accessibility): keyboard accessibility: table should use role="grid" with roving tabindex for rows; arrow keys to move focus, Space toggles selection, Enter opens inspector. Ensure tooltips are accessible with aria-describedby and can be triggered by keyboard focus. Ben (Eng): noted. We'll implement roving tabindex and aria-selected on rows. For hidden selected rows, the pill will be interactive and open a filtered view. For streaming vs background: <=10k rows return streaming CSV, >10k enqueue job and send S3 presigned link. Annalise (Design): small UX decision: should selecting a saved filter preset auto-apply or stage? prefer stage so the user can confirm with "Apply & preview" — avoids accidental changes. Add a tiny unsaved dot on the Apply button when staged != active. Noah (PM): agree. acceptance criteria: selection persists across filters, hidden-count visible, relevance label + tooltip, staged rerank flow with preview badge, export modal copy + estimate, checksum toggle, streaming threshold, and keyboard/a11y requirements. I'll add to the ticket. ExportBot: Export queued: job_id=exp_2f9b. You'll receive a channel message and email when complete. Annalise (Design): thanks — i'll post updated mock with the pill state, preview badge, and modal copy tweaks in ~90m. will include a11y handoff notes for aria-live and grid roles. :sparkles:
